name: Circuit de Monaco
blurb: Circuit de Monaco: 3.337 km and 19 turns through the streets of Monte Carlo and La Condamine around Port Hercule, home of the Monaco Grand Prix.

facts.Signature sections: Sainte Devote, the climb to Casino Square, the Fairmont hairpin, the tunnel, the harbour chicane, Tabac, the Swimming Pool, Rascasse
facts.Venue data: The circuit was traced from the official 2026 Monaco Grand Prix map onto OpenStreetMap roads and is approximate (about 2% shorter than the official lap). Grandstand letters, access gates, first aid, toilets, public parking, footbridges and ticket points come from that map; positions are approximate. Hospitality and yacht viewing are on a separate Senate Grand Prix map and are not placed. Layouts change each year.
